알림 규칙

어떤 이벤트가 생기면 누구에게 어떻게 알릴지 정하는 화면입니다. 조건과 동작을 나눠 받고, 저장하기 전에 규칙을 한 문장으로 보여 줍니다.

언제 쓰는가
Critical 이벤트가 짧은 시간에 몰리는 것처럼 사람이 바로 알아야 하는 조건을 정해 메일이나 웹훅으로 알릴 때 씁니다.
비슷한 패턴
정해진 때마다 요약을 보내는 것은 보고서 · 예약 발송을, 탐지와 차단 동작 자체를 정하는 것은 정책 설정을 씁니다.

Composition

이 패턴이 조합하는 컴포넌트입니다. 세부 옵션은 각 컴포넌트 페이지에 있습니다.

.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.375rem;height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:var(--font-size-14);font-weight:600;line-height:1.25rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;transition:background var(--motion-fast),border-color var(--motion-fast);letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.btn.sm{height:2rem;padding:0 0.875rem;font-size:var(--font-size-12);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);line-height:max(1rem,16px);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.btn.md{height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.btn.lg{height:3rem;padding:0 1.625rem;font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.0057em}
.btn:where(.solid.primary){background:var(--surface-brand-primary);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient);color:var(--brand-label)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-strong);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-heavy);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary){border-color:var(--line-brand-strong);color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive){background:var(--surface-neutral-tertiary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive){border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative){background:var(--surface-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative){border-color:var(--line-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed);border-color:var(--line-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn.text{padding-left:0.5rem;padding-right:0.5rem}
.btn:where(.text):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.text):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.notice.danger .btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn.icon-only{width:2.5rem;padding:0}
.btn.icon-only.sm{width:2rem}
.btn.icon-only.lg{width:3rem}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative){color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed)}
.btn svg{width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;flex:none}
.btn.sm svg{width:1rem;height:1rem}
.btn.lg svg{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem;stroke-width:1.6}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.btn[disabled],.btn[aria-disabled="true"]{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);border-color:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.btn:where(.outline)[disabled],.btn:where(.outline)[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--surface-disable-primary)}
.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[disabled],.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent}
.btn.loading{position:relative;color:transparent;cursor:progress}
.btn.loading::after{content:"";position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;color:var(--brand-label);animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
.btn.sm.loading::after{width:1rem;height:1rem}
.btn.lg.loading::after{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem}
.btn:where(.assistive).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary,.text:not(.assistive),.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.negative:not(.text)).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn-group{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;line-height:1.6}
.btn-group.end{justify-content:flex-end;width:100%}
.btn-group.vertical{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
.btn-group:has(> .btn.sm){gap:0.375rem}
.btn-group:has(> .btn.lg){gap:0.75rem}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.375rem;min-width:16.25rem;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.field label:where(:not(.checkbox):not(.radio)){font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field label b{font-weight:700}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])),.field textarea{height:2.5rem;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 0.875rem;font:inherit;font-size:var(--font-size-14);background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:6rem;padding:0.625rem 0.875rem;resize:vertical;line-height:1.375rem}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--line-field-focus);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-field-focus-halo);outline:none}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .help{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:var(--font-size-12);contain:inline-size;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:max(1rem,16px);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.field.error input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])),.field.error textarea,.field.error .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary)}
.field.error input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):focus,.field.error textarea:focus-within,.field.error .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-negative-focus)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field .help:empty{margin-top:-0.375rem}
.field .counter.over{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field .affix .reveal{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem;margin-right:-0.375rem;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);cursor:pointer}
.field .affix .reveal:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.field .affix .reveal:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.field .affix .reveal span{display:grid}
.field .affix .reveal svg{width:1.125rem;height:1.125rem}
.field .affix .reveal[aria-pressed="true"] .i-show,.field .affix .reveal:not([aria-pressed="true"]) .i-hide{display:none}

.dropdown .menu[data-actions]{min-width:max(100%,12.5rem)}

.dropdown[data-multiple][data-overflow="wrap"] .trigger .trigger-text{white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all}

.card{background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);padding:var(--card-pad);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem;min-width:16.25rem;position:relative;line-height:1.6}

.card .card-meta.columns dt{font-size:var(--font-size-13);line-height:1.125rem;letter-spacing:0.0194em;font-weight:500}
.card .card-meta.columns dd{font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.0057em}
.card .card-meta.columns{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}

import { useFormDraft, Button, ButtonGroup, Checkbox, Combobox, Field, Form, FormActions, FormLegend, FormRow, FormSection, Notice, NumberInput, Select, TextField } from "@jiran/ds-react";

const SEVS = ["Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low", "Info"].map((label) => ({ value: label, label }));
const TARGETS = [{ value: "all", label: "전체 단말" }, { value: "server", label: "서버 그룹" }, { value: "sales", label: "영업팀 PC" }];
const WINDOWS = [{ value: "5", label: "5분 안에" }, { value: "10", label: "10분 안에" }, { value: "60", label: "1시간 안에" }];
const PEOPLE = ["보안팀", "운영팀", "김민준", "이서연"].map((label) => ({ value: label, label }));

/* 조건은 모두 맞아야 하고 동작은 하나 이상. 저장 버튼 위에 규칙을 한 문장으로 */
export default function Example() {
  const draft = useFormDraft("alert-rule-new");
  return (
    <Form ref={draft.ref} validate onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
      {draft.notice}
      <FormLegend />
      <TextField id="ar-name" label="규칙 이름" required defaultValue="랜섬웨어 연속 탐지" />
      <FormSection>조건</FormSection>
      <Field label="심각도" htmlFor="ar-sev" required>
        <Combobox id="ar-sev" multiple required options={SEVS} defaultValue={["Critical", "High"]} placeholder="심각도 선택" label="심각도" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="대상">
        <Select options={TARGETS} defaultValue="all" label="대상" keepMounted />
      </Field>
      <FormRow>
        <NumberInput id="ar-count" label="횟수" defaultValue="5" min={1} max={100} unit="건 이상" help="1~100" />
        <Field label="시간 창">
          <Select options={WINDOWS} defaultValue="10" label="시간 창" keepMounted />
        </Field>
      </FormRow>
      <FormSection>동작</FormSection>
      <Checkbox defaultChecked>메일 보내기</Checkbox>
      <Field label="받는 사람" htmlFor="ar-mail">
        <Combobox id="ar-mail" multiple options={PEOPLE} defaultValue={["보안팀"]} placeholder="사람 또는 부서 검색" label="받는 사람" />
      </Field>
      <Checkbox defaultChecked>웹훅 호출</Checkbox>
      <TextField id="ar-hook" label="웹훅 주소" type="url" defaultValue="https://hooks.example.com/js-alert" help="테스트 전송으로 받는 쪽을 확인하세요." messages={{ url: "https:// 로 시작하는 주소를 입력하세요." }} />
      <ButtonGroup><Button variant="outline" color="assistive" size="sm">테스트 전송</Button></ButtonGroup>
      <Notice title="규칙 요약">Critical · High 이벤트가 전체 단말에서 10분 안에 5건 이상 생기면 보안팀에 메일을 보내고 웹훅을 호출합니다.</Notice>
      <FormActions>
        <ButtonGroup>
          <Button variant="outline" color="assistive">취소</Button>
          <Button type="submit">저장</Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      </FormActions>
    </Form>
  );
}

2. 불러오는 중 · 빈 결과 · 오류

.banner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;width:100%;padding:0.625rem 1.25rem;background:var(--surface-brand-primary);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient);color:var(--brand-label);font-size:var(--font-size-14);font-weight:500;line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}

.banner:not(.warning):not(.danger) .btn:where(.outline.assistive:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])){color:var(--brand-label)}
.banner:not(.warning):not(.danger) .btn:where(.outline.assistive:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-strong)}
.banner:not(.warning):not(.danger) .btn:where(.outline.assistive:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-heavy)}
.banner:not(.warning):not(.danger) .btn:where(.outline.assistive).loading::after{color:var(--brand-label)}
.banner .btn:focus-visible{outline-color:currentColor}
.banner .btn:is(.loading,[aria-disabled="true"]):focus-visible{outline-color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}

.spinner{display:inline-block;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;border:3px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);border-top-color:var(--surface-brand-primary);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite;line-height:1.6}

.tbl .num{text-align:right}

.tbl.kv th{width:12.5rem;height:auto;padding:0.75rem 1rem;font-size:var(--font-size-13);color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);font-weight:500;border-right:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);white-space:normal;vertical-align:top;line-height:1.125rem;letter-spacing:0.0194em}

.tbl-wrap.sticky{scroll-padding-top:2.75rem}

.select-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.5rem;padding:0.25rem 1rem;background:var(--surface-brand-subtle);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}

@keyframes ds-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0.5rem)}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes ds-delay{from{visibility:hidden}to{visibility:visible}}
@keyframes shimmer{to{transform:translateX(100%)}}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px transparent}}
React · @jiran/ds-react
import { Button, Card, CardHead, CardTitle, DataTable, Stack, type DataTableColumn } from "@jiran/ds-react";

type Row = { id: string; c0: string; c1: string; c2: string };
const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Row>[] = [
  { key: "c0", header: "규칙" },
  { key: "c1", header: "조건" },
  { key: "c2", header: "알림" },
];

/* 불러오는 중 · 빈 결과 · 오류 — 불러오기와 다시 시도는 제품이 하고, 표는 상태만 바꾼다 */
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Card flush>
        <CardHead><CardTitle>불러오는 중</CardTitle></CardHead>
        <DataTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={[] as Row[]} rowKey={(r) => r.id} status="loading" statusLabel="알림 규칙 불러오는 중" loadingRows={3} />
      </Card>
      <Card flush>
        <CardHead><CardTitle>첫 사용</CardTitle></CardHead>
        <DataTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={[] as Row[]} rowKey={(r) => r.id} empty={<div className="empty">아직 만든 알림 규칙이 없습니다. <Button size="sm">규칙 만들기</Button></div>} />
      </Card>
      <Card flush>
        <CardHead><CardTitle>불러오기 실패</CardTitle></CardHead>
        <DataTable columns={COLUMNS} rows={[] as Row[]} rowKey={(r) => r.id} status="error" errorText="알림 규칙을 불러오지 못했습니다. 네트워크 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도하세요." onRetry={() => {}} />
      </Card>
    </Stack>
  );
}

Rules

조건과 동작
조건과 동작을 섹션으로 나눕니다. 조건은 모두 맞아야 하고, 동작은 하나 이상 고릅니다.
조건
심각도와 대상, 횟수와 시간 창을 받습니다. 횟수와 시간 창은 '10분 안에 5건 이상' 처럼 한 줄로 읽히게 둡니다.
동작
메일은 받는 사람을, 웹훅은 주소를 받습니다. 웹훅은 저장하기 전에 테스트 전송으로 확인할 수 있게 합니다.
요약 문장
저장 버튼 위에 규칙을 한 문장으로 보여 주고, 값을 바꾸면 바로 고칩니다.
알림 묶기
같은 규칙의 알림은 시간 창 안에서 한 번만 보냅니다. 같은 이벤트로 알림이 쏟아지지 않게 합니다.
검증
필수 값과 웹훅 주소 형식은 입력 검증으로 확인합니다. 저장을 누르면 첫 오류로 이동합니다.

Usage

React 제품은 디자인 시스템 패키지를 설치하고 스타일 파일을 한 번 불러오면 위 React 탭 코드를 그대로 쓸 수 있습니다. 설치 방법은 React Package 에 있습니다. HTML 제품은 공통 스타일 파일을 연결하고, 일부만 필요하면 아래 컴포넌트 CSS 를 복사합니다. 동작이 필요하면 동작 스크립트를 함께 넣습니다. 이 페이지의 미리보기도 그 스크립트로 움직입니다. 색은 모두 토큰을 따르므로 제품 색 하나를 고르면 나머지가 따라옵니다.

React @jiran/ds-react

npm i @jiran/ds-react

// main.tsx — 앱 진입점에서 한 번
import "@jiran/ds-react/style.css";

// 컴포넌트
import { Form, Combobox, NumberInput, Checkbox, DataTable, Card, FormLegend, FormSection, FormRow, FormActions, Field, TextField, TextArea, CodeInput, Select, CheckboxGroup, Notice, Toast, ToastStack, Banner, ToastProvider, useToast, Button, ButtonGroup, ActionBar, CardHead, CardTitle, CardDesc, CardMeta, CardFoot, CardGrid, Spinner, Skeleton, SkeletonRow, Progress, Empty } from "@jiran/ds-react";

HTML

<!-- 1) 토큰 + 전체 컴포넌트 스타일 한 번에 연결 -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/style.css">
<!-- 동작(드롭다운·탭·달력·표 정렬/선택·토스트 등) — 순수 JS 한 파일. React 제품은 불필요 -->
<script src="assets/ds.js" defer></script>

<!-- 2) 또는 아래 "Component CSS" 만 프로젝트 CSS 에 붙이고,
        :root 토큰은 Foundations › Design Token 에서 복사 -->

복사본의 전제

아래 "Component CSS" 만 붙일 때는 이 규칙들과 Pretendard(assets/fonts) · :root 토큰을 전제로 그려집니다 — assets/style.css 의 값 그대로입니다. 앱에 같은 규칙이 있으면 넣지 않아도 됩니다.

*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--background-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:break-word}
code,kbd{font-family:var(--font-sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

Component CSS .form, .form-legend, .field, .code-inputs, .combobox, .menu-state, .dropdown, .menu, .menu-item, .menu-mark, .menu-items, .menu-actions, .number-field, .num-btn, .checkbox, .checkbox-group, .notice, .toast, .toast-stack, .banner, .btn, .btn-group, .tbl-wrap, .tbl, .action-bar, .select-notice, .tag, .indicator, .card, .card-grid, .spinner, .spinner-wrap, .skeleton, .skeleton-row, .progress, .progress-row, .empty, .stack, .sr-only, .chip

/* JS Design System v0.9 · .form, .form-legend, .field, .code-inputs, .combobox, .menu-state, .dropdown, .menu, .menu-item, .menu-mark, .menu-items, .menu-actions, .number-field, .num-btn, .checkbox, .checkbox-group, .notice, .toast, .toast-stack, .banner, .btn, .btn-group, .tbl-wrap, .tbl, .action-bar, .select-notice, .tag, .indicator, .card, .card-grid, .spinner, .spinner-wrap, .skeleton, .skeleton-row, .progress, .progress-row, .empty, .stack, .sr-only, .chip · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.375rem;height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:var(--font-size-14);font-weight:600;line-height:1.25rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;transition:background var(--motion-fast),border-color var(--motion-fast);letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.btn.sm{height:2rem;padding:0 0.875rem;font-size:var(--font-size-12);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);line-height:max(1rem,16px);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.btn.md{height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.25rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.btn.lg{height:3rem;padding:0 1.625rem;font-size:var(--font-size-16);line-height:1.5rem;letter-spacing:0.0057em}
.btn:where(.solid.primary){background:var(--surface-brand-primary);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient);color:var(--brand-label)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-strong);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-heavy);background-image:var(--surface-brand-gradient-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary){border-color:var(--line-brand-strong);color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive){background:var(--surface-neutral-tertiary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive){border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative){background:var(--surface-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative){border-color:var(--line-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed);border-color:var(--line-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn.text{padding-left:0.5rem;padding-right:0.5rem}
.btn:where(.text):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.text):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.notice.danger .btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn.icon-only{width:2.5rem;padding:0}
.btn.icon-only.sm{width:2rem}
.btn.icon-only.lg{width:3rem}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative){color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):where(:not(.loading,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"])):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed)}
.btn svg{width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;flex:none}
.btn.sm svg{width:1rem;height:1rem}
.btn.lg svg{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem;stroke-width:1.6}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.btn[disabled],.btn[aria-disabled="true"]{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);border-color:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.btn:where(.outline)[disabled],.btn:where(.outline)[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--surface-disable-primary)}
.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[disabled],.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent}
.btn.loading{position:relative;color:transparent;cursor:progress}
.btn.loading::after{content:"";position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;color:var(--brand-label);animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
.btn.sm.loading::after{width:1rem;height:1rem}
.btn.lg.loading::after{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem}
.btn:where(.assistive).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary,.text:not(.assistive),.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.negative:not(.text)).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn-group{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;line-height:1.6}
.btn-group.end{justify-content:flex-end;width:100%}
.btn-group.vertical{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}
.btn-group:has(> .btn.sm){gap:0.375rem}
.btn-group:has(> .btn.lg){gap:0.75rem}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.375rem;min-width:16.25rem;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.field label:where(:not(.checkbox):not(.radio)){font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field label b{font-weight:700}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])),.field textarea{height:2.5rem;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 0.875rem;font:inherit;font-size:var(--font-size-14);background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:6rem;padding:0.625rem 0.875rem;resize:vertical;line-height:1.375rem}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--line-field-focus);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-field-focus-halo);outline:none}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .help{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:var(--font-size-12);contain:inline-size;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:max(1rem,16px);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.field.error input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])),.field.error textarea,.field.error .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary)}
.field.error input:where(:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range])):focus,.field.error textarea:focus-within,.field.error .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-negative-focus)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field .help:empty{margin-top:-0.375rem}

.card{background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);padding:var(--card-pad);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem;min-width:16.25rem;position:relative;line-height:1.6}

.tbl th.sortable{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.tbl th.sortable::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:0.875rem;height:0.875rem;margin-left:0.375rem;vertical-align:-0.1875rem;opacity:.45;background:currentColor;-webkit-mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2224%22 height=%2224%22 viewBox=%220 0 24 24%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22black%22 stroke-width=%222%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22 %3E%3Cpath d=%22M3 9l4 -4l4 4m-4 -4v14%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M21 15l-4 4l-4 -4m4 4v-14%22 /%3E%3C/svg%3E") center/contain no-repeat;mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2224%22 height=%2224%22 viewBox=%220 0 24 24%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22black%22 stroke-width=%222%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22 %3E%3Cpath d=%22M3 9l4 -4l4 4m-4 -4v14%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M21 15l-4 4l-4 -4m4 4v-14%22 /%3E%3C/svg%3E") center/contain no-repeat}
.tbl th.sortable .sort{appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;margin:0;font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radius-xs)}
.tbl th.sortable .sort{position:relative}
.tbl th.sortable .sort::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:max(100%,1.5rem);height:max(100%,1.5rem);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.tbl th.sortable:hover{color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}

.tbl th.sorted::after{opacity:1;-webkit-mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2224%22 height=%2224%22 viewBox=%220 0 24 24%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22black%22 stroke-width=%222%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22 %3E%3Cpath d=%22M12 5l0 14%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M18 11l-6 -6%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M6 11l6 -6%22 /%3E%3C/svg%3E") center/contain no-repeat;mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2224%22 height=%2224%22 viewBox=%220 0 24 24%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22black%22 stroke-width=%222%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22 %3E%3Cpath d=%22M12 5l0 14%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M18 11l-6 -6%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M6 11l6 -6%22 /%3E%3C/svg%3E") center/contain no-repeat}
.tbl th.sorted.desc::after{-webkit-mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2224%22 height=%2224%22 viewBox=%220 0 24 24%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22black%22 stroke-width=%222%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22 %3E%3Cpath d=%22M12 5l0 14%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M18 13l-6 6%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M6 13l6 6%22 /%3E%3C/svg%3E") center/contain no-repeat;mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2224%22 height=%2224%22 viewBox=%220 0 24 24%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22black%22 stroke-width=%222%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22 %3E%3Cpath d=%22M12 5l0 14%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M18 13l-6 6%22 /%3E%3Cpath d=%22M6 13l6 6%22 /%3E%3C/svg%3E") center/contain no-repeat}
.tbl .num{text-align:right}
.tbl td svg{vertical-align:middle}

.tbl .actions{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}

.tbl td.expand{padding-top:0;padding-bottom:0}

.tbl .expand-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);cursor:pointer}

.tbl tr.row-detail > td{height:auto;padding:1rem 1rem 1.25rem 3.5rem;background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}

.tbl .detail-meta dd{margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.tbl .row-detail .spinner-wrap{flex-direction:row;font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.tbl.kv th{width:12.5rem;height:auto;padding:0.75rem 1rem;font-size:var(--font-size-13);color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);font-weight:500;border-right:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);white-space:normal;vertical-align:top;line-height:1.125rem;letter-spacing:0.0194em}
.tbl.kv td{height:auto}
.tbl.kv tr:first-child > *{border-top:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.side-panel .tbl.kv th{width:7.5rem;border-right:0}
.tbl td.empty{display:table-cell;text-align:center;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);height:auto;padding:1.5rem 1rem;border:none;border-radius:0;background:transparent}
.tbl td.truncate{max-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td.truncate>.tooltip-wrap{display:flex;max-width:100%}
.tbl td.truncate .cell-text{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl.grid :is(th,td):not(:last-child){border-right:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl.plain td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl .cell-sub{display:block;font-size:var(--font-size-12);line-height:max(1rem,16px);color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary);letter-spacing:0.0252em}
.tbl td:has(> .cell-sub){padding-top:0.5rem;padding-bottom:0.5rem}
.tbl tr.disabled .cell-sub{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}
.tbl tfoot tr.total td{font-weight:600;--tbl-tint:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl:has(> tfoot tr.total) > tbody > tr:last-child > td{border-bottom-color:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col{--tbl-surface:var(--background-neutral-primary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl{width:max-content;min-width:100%}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl :is(th,td){white-space:nowrap}
.tbl.nowrap :is(th,td){white-space:nowrap}
.tbl.nowrap td.empty{white-space:normal}
.card .tbl-wrap:is(.sticky-col,.sticky),.side-panel .tbl-wrap:is(.sticky-col,.sticky),.popup .tbl-wrap:is(.sticky-col,.sticky){--tbl-surface:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :where(:first-child:not(.empty),.expand:first-child + *,.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){position:sticky;left:0;z-index:1}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(.expand:first-child + *){left:2.5rem}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(.check:first-child + *){left:2.75rem}

.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > td:is(:first-child:not(.empty),.expand:first-child + *,.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){background:linear-gradient(var(--tbl-tint,transparent),var(--tbl-tint,transparent)) var(--tbl-surface)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky-col .tbl tr:not(.row-detail) > :is(:first-child:not(.check,.expand,.empty),.expand:first-child + :not(.check),.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){box-shadow:inset -1px 0 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky.sticky-col .tbl th:is(:first-child,.expand:first-child + *,.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){z-index:2}
.tbl-wrap.sticky.sticky-col .tbl th:is(:first-child:not(.check,.expand),.expand:first-child + :not(.check),.check:first-child + *,.expand:first-child + .check + *){box-shadow:inset -1px 0 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary),inset 0 -1px 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.tbl-wrap.sticky{scroll-padding-top:2.75rem}
.tbl-wrap.sticky .tbl th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--line-neutral-secondary)}

.tbl-wrap.sticky:has(> .action-bar:not([hidden])){scroll-padding-top:6.0625rem}
.select-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.5rem;padding:0.25rem 1rem;background:var(--surface-brand-subtle);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);font-size:var(--font-size-14);line-height:1.375rem;letter-spacing:0.0145em}
.select-notice:empty{display:none}
.tbl .link{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.tbl tr:where(:not(.disabled)) .link:hover{text-decoration:underline}

.tile[disabled] .tag::before{background:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}

.form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.25rem;width:100%;max-width:40rem;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);padding:1.5rem;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);line-height:1.6}
